# Содержимое файла userEntryControl.ts {#sec-api-userEntryControl .appendix}

``` python
import {Response, Request} from 'express'
import { createDb, getQuery, runQuery } from '../../db/queryDb';
import { buildOvpFile, generateClientCertificate } from '../../vpnConf';
import { UserRoleType } from '../../types/user';

type UserRegReqType = {
    username: string,
    hash_password: string,
    role: UserRoleType
}

type UserLoginReqType = {
    username: string,
    hash_password: string
}

type UserShortCodeReqType = {
    username: string,
    code: string
}

type UserFastEntryReqType = {
    username: string,
    passCode: string
}


export const userRegistration = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {username, hash_password, role}: UserRegReqType  = req.body;

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {

        await runQuery(
            db,
            `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vpn_users (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            username TEXT NOT NULL,
            hash_password TEXT NOT NULL,
            role TEXT NOT NULL,
            ip_addr TEXT
            );`,
            []
        )

        const result = await runQuery(
            db,
            `INSERT INTO vpn_users (username, hash_password, role)
            SELECT ?, ?, ?
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vpn_users WHERE username = ?);`,
            [username, hash_password, role, username]
        )

        if (result.changes === 0 ) {
            db.close();
            res.json({success: false, text: "Пользователь с таким именем существует"});

        } else {
            await generateClientCertificate(username);
            const ovpnContent = await buildOvpFile(username);

            res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-openvpn-profile');
            res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${username}.ovpn"`);

            db.close()

            res.send({success: true, text: ovpnContent});
        }

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: "Прозошла непредвиденная ошибка"
        })
    }
}

export const userLogin = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {username, hash_password}: UserLoginReqType = req.body

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const userHashInfoResp = await getQuery<{
            hash_password: string
        }>(
            db,
            `SELECT hash_password FROM vpn_users
            WHERE username = ?`,
            [username]
        )

        db.close()

        const userHash = userHashInfoResp[0]

        if (userHash.hash_password !== hash_password) {
            res.json({success: false, text: 'Неверный логин или пароль'})
        } else {
            res.json({success: true})
        }

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: "Прозошла непредвиденная ошибка"
        })
    }
}

export const userSetShortCode = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {username, code}: UserShortCodeReqType = req.body;

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const idUserResp = await getQuery<{
            id: number
        }>(
            db,
            `SELECT id FROM vpn_users WHERE username = ?;`,
            [username]
        )

        const idUser = idUserResp[0].id

        if (!!idUser) {
            await runQuery(
                db,
                `UPDATE vpn_users SET short_code = ? WHERE username = ?;`,
                [code, idUser]
            )

            db.close()

            res.json({success: true, info: []})
        }

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: "Прозошла непредвиденная ошибка"
        })
    }
}

export const userFastEntry = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {username, passCode}: UserFastEntryReqType = req.body
    
    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const dataResp = await getQuery<{
            short_code: string
        }>(
            db,
            `SELECT short_code FROM vpn_users WHERE username = ?`,
            [username]
        )

        const code = dataResp[0].short_code

        if (Number(code) !== Number(passCode)) {
            res.json({
                success: false,
                text: 'Неверный код'
            })
        } else {
            res.json({
                success: true,
                info: []
            })
        }

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}
```
